top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 child needs emergency care authorization to be redone due to water damage on form.

top_violation_types.title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing information on the parents receiving the operational policies.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's files were missing emergency contact addresses.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff files reviewed did not have the required Health and Safety training topic certificates for the last full year of training.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The director did not have the required 30 hours of annual training.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.
